Pree, I couldn't confirm an 8 April renewal date for Brackenwater Freight Co. I checked the brain and the shared files I can see, and neither has a Brackenwater renewal date. The brain search is keyword-only, so a miss there isn't proof the date doesn't exist.

Brackenwater is a North team account. A September 2025 handoff note moved it to Marcus Lindqvist, so he's the person to confirm the date with. The renewal date itself should come from the signed contract or Marcus's account record, not from an overheard call.
